summary: Ferrovial N.V. filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) announcing an extension of its existing share repurchase program launched on 12 December 2025. The program's authorization caps are unchanged at EUR 800,000,000 and 15 million shares; the duration is extended from 15 October 2026 to 3 March 2027. Through 11 September 2026, Ferrovial had repurchased 6,180,574 shares for EUR 357,895,778.40. No advisor or board recommendation is named. Watch execution pace, remaining capacity, and any further extension or early termination.
